name: what's AVALON?
source:
Enter the world of AVALON...

what's AVALON? is a short visual novel about a virtual world and the secrets of its development. You play as John, an average yet slightly aggressive businessman taking some much-needed time off in the world of Avalon. Things don't go as planned, however, and he quickly finds himself face-to-face with ZX5, one of the many AI running this seemingly idyllic paradise. Confronted with his own issues of identity and sexuality, John's vacation takes quite an unexpected turn.

[From [url=https://articution.itch.io/whats-avalon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
進入AVALON的世界……

《what's AVALON?》是一部關於虛擬世界及其開發秘密的短篇視覺小說。你將扮演普通、卻有些咄咄逼人的商人John，在Avalon世界中享受一段急需的假期。然而，事情並未按計畫發展，他很快便與ZX5正面相遇。ZX5是維持這座看似田園般美好的樂園運轉的眾多人工智慧之一。當John不得不面對自身的身分認同與性傾向問題時，他的假期發生了意想不到的轉折。

[摘自[url=https://articution.itch.io/whats-avalon]itch.io[/url]]
